dedupe_keys.name: registry office map data 登記所備付地図 published through the g space information center

description: Since 23 January 2023 Japan's Ministry of Justice has released the electronic data of the maps kept at registry offices, the parcel maps and map-equivalent drawings under Article 14 of the Real Property Registration Act, free of charge through the G-Space Information Center. The data come from the Legal Affairs Bureaus' map information system in the processable map XML format; the latest update, published on 15 April 2026, extracts the map data as of February 2026. The ministry expects the data to be used with public service information and in urban planning, community development and disaster response. Coverage: registry maps held for all of Japan. Access: downloads from the G-Space Information Center, free. Licence: not stated on the page read. Caveats: map XML must be converted with software before it can be shown as a map; the released data have no certifying function and do not replace map certificates issued by the bureaus; the data include both registry maps and map-equivalent drawings. Simulation uses are land parcel geometry for building exposure, land readjustment and post-disaster recovery planning. Related records: the MLIT Real Estate Information Library and PLATEAU 3D city models.
